reviews.author: Chris Wainwright
reviews.text: I would not hesitate to hire Lion of Judah again! Nelson and his team do great work and they stand by it. Nelson, the owner, was there to immediately address any of my questions or concerns. If you’re looking for a contractor that does excellent work and truly cares that you are satisfied with the project, Lion of Judah Roofing is the contractor to go with!

reviews.author: Candido Rodriguez
reviews.text: I couldn’t be happier with my experience working with Nelson and his team on my basement finishing project. He completely transformed my unfinished basement. From the very beginning, Nelson was incredibly professional, responsive, and easy to communicate with. He walked me through the entire process step by step, making sure I understood everything and felt confident at every stage. His transparency really stood out and there were no surprises, just clear expectations and honest guidance. Nelson’s staff were absolutely the best. They were respectful, skilled, and paid extremely close attention to detail throughout the project. The craftsmanship truly shows in the final result, and it’s clear they take pride in their work. They went above and beyond to ensure everything was done right and to the highest standard. I highly recommend Nelson to anyone interested in home finishing. If you’re looking for a contractor who is professional, thorough, and genuinely cares about delivering top-quality results, Nelson and his team are the ones to call.

reviews.author: loretta iannuzzi
reviews.text: Nelson and his team from Lion of Judah put a new roof on my home and did a major renovation of the kitchen and 2 full bathroom remodels. They also did other jobs and renovations including painting, landscaping, replacing floors throughout and sectioning off a part of the basement. All the work done throughout my home was exceptional. I highly recommend this company for any remodeling or roofing needs. You won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: gina
reviews.text: Choosing Lion of Judah roofing for my family’s needs was the best choice I could have ever made. The owner was very friendly and helpful, he made his crew available immediately to get the job done. It was done well and cleaned up nicely afterwards and the pricing was unbeatable. We look forward to working with them again on other projects around our home and will be recommending them to our family and friends.

reviews.author: Kristi Mercado
reviews.text: These guys are great! They completed 2 roofs for us this summer. We just had a gutter fall down at another property and they came out the same day. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Idaliz
reviews.text: I reached out to them at the last minute, and they were still able to come the same day to clear the snow from my long driveway. They did an excellent job, and I was very pleased with the results. Their customer service was great, they were polite, and I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Moon Gazer
reviews.text: I hired Nelson and Lion of Judah for a wide variety of jobs on a few different occasions . Him and his men did outstanding work on my kitchen cabinets as well as fixed and installed plumbing in the kitchen . Lion of Judah also fixed the outside of my detached garage and fixed an underground plumbing issue on my property. Since then I have recommended him to my family and friends and coworkers who all rave about him ,what impresses me most is how they are always punctual, well mannered and most of all honest . His work is top notch and reasonable . I can’t say enough about him , Sincerely Dave Montgomery

reviews.author: Alexia Francis
reviews.text: They did my bathroom renovation and basement renovation! They worked really fast and were extremely professional and clean! I highly recommend working with them!

reviews.author: RL.Francis
reviews.text: We did renovations with Nelson and his team and couldn't have asked for a better experience. We've recommended them to everyone!

reviews.author: Bobby Kobylinski
reviews.text: Very direct, right to the point, professional, fair price and great jog with our roof. I recommend them. They cleaned up after done, did my roof in one full day. After several rainy day, everything still looks good. Just recommended them to our neighbors too.

reviews.author: Rebecca Gardella
reviews.text: We are so happy we went with Lion of Judah Roofing for our new roof! Nelson worked with us over the course of several months as we prepared to buy a home that needed a new roof for insurance sake. He patched a spot that was damaged prior to fixing so that we would not incur more damage. Additionally, he brought us samples of shingles so that I could look at the roof and make a final decision. Nelson was active in communicating with us - and letting us know where we were in his schedule and how rain would impact timing. On roof day, his team was respectful and kind! They waved at my kids as they eagerly watched from the windows. His team is professional - they checked for nails in our yard over and over again, and we haven't found a single one! I appreciate that they took the time to make sure our kids can safely play in our yard. Our roof looks amazing! They made sure it was properly vented, which was not the case prior. 10/10 would hire his team to complete more work for us!

reviews.author: Josiah Garcia
reviews.text: Lion of Judah Roofing provided professional service and quality workmanship. Communication was clear, and the project was completed on schedule. I would confidently recommend them.

reviews.author: Iveth De La Cruz
reviews.text: Great company! They did a good job on the roof. Fast, friendly, and cleaned up after. Very happy with the work. 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.author: Amanda Tolbert
reviews.text: My roof was horrible falling down holes you name it. This gentleman came, went above and beyond and now my roof is beautiful. They also redid my whole shower. It was falling apart and needed to be redone and made that an outstanding job. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Lyssa Dyer
reviews.text: Great roofing company. Came out to inspect my roof for insurance company. Gave an honest inspection. Had few issues that they promptly fixed. Very fair pricing. Work was completed and I am highly satisfied with company.

reviews.author: Mark Vandzura
reviews.text: Great roofers, haven’t used them for anything else yet, but I plan on it. Nelson is a great guy and great to work with. 2 Months later - Nelson and his team did some remodeling for me and they did a fabulous job. Everything exceeded my expectations. Thanks Nelson.

reviews.author: Gabe Vandzura
reviews.text: Nelson and his crew are fantastic. He put new windows, doors and siding on my brothers house and it looks fabulous. Great attention to detail.

reviews.author: Bea K
reviews.text: Great service, we've used Lion of Judah Roofing seveveral times, including fixing the roof, plumbing, and kitchen detailing. We will certainly use their expertise again. Nelson's skills and attention to detail are impressive! Beata K.

reviews.author: ariany Marie
reviews.text: i called lion of judah to replace my toilet and my house flooring, he and his workers did an amazing job.

reviews.author: Jodie Beamer
reviews.text: Lion of Judah roofing not only did they do an amazing job they came out the next day with a quote and had the work down the following week .Their prices were more than reasonable.iI highly recommend them and plan on using them for a flooring project!!!

reviews.author: Jeremiah Jimenez
reviews.text: I appreciate the professionalism and effort shown by Lion of Judah Roofing. They took the time to answer questions and made sure the job was done right.

reviews.author: Kevin Jimenez
reviews.text: Amazing work that these guys did, they were up and out with the roof of my house in no time. 100% would recommend to anyone that is in the process of redoing their roof!

reviews.author: Evan Vandzura
reviews.text: They did a great job! Everything was done quickly and efficiently. Very professional! The work they did turned out great!

reviews.author: Lovunia Devito
reviews.text: Wonderfull company, I hired them to replace my roof and gutters. The owner is very nice and I would definitely hire them again for other projects.

reviews.author: sam li
reviews.text: This is a legit team. Just did a renovation by this company. They are responsible and fairly priced and they did a very good job. The owner is a honest and respectable gentleman.

reviews.author: Yessica Resptrepo
reviews.text: Lion of Judah Roofing did an excellent job repairing my roof. The service was fast, the team was professional, and the quality of the work was outstanding. 100% recommended!
